decisions.statement: Every word this takes is a flag or a flag's value.
A flag this does not take is refused rather than passed over.
Naming both frames has the model interpolate the first frame to the last.
Naming the last frame alone has the model make the lead-in to that frame.
One workload runs on the GPU at a time.
Nothing here waits for the GPU to come free.
Nothing here starts the container or provisions the weights.
A render that threw after staging names that staging in its refusal.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.

definition: the command rendering one clip conditioned on a first frame, a last frame, or both
